question: Which guarded core-stat continuation reaches the first selected stack stores through comparison, override and ordinal retry, and where do presentation and participant continuations remain unjoined?

scope.generatedOnlyLeadsQualification: This inventory describes the original read set. coreStatContinuitySupport now supplies narrow native-word evidence for the preparation target 0x82D7D730 and its selected bypass. The other three helper leads retain their generated-only status. No complete preparation-target body or unselected-arm behavior is established.
scope.boundary: Partial local blocks and endpoints, with guarded core-stat continuity through weighting into frame loads in coreStatContinuity, through the actual selection reads/comparison in frameToSelection and through override and finite ordinal success into first stack stores in selectionStoreJoin. generatedOnlyLeads describes the original read set. The preparation-target bypass has narrow native support in coreStatContinuitySupport; the other three leads and six excluded data cells retain their evidence limits. Presentation contents and transfer remain unjoined. The transfer read set ends before 0x827F8688; no complete resolver coverage is asserted.

resolverLocalSupport.qualification: The original readWindows and queriedDistinctWords inventory remain separate accepted support. These resolver windows close only the named fallthroughs and local pointer producer/retention. Disjoint support between their endpoints does not establish a complete core-pair-to-selection path. No helper, presentation, transfer or participant-writer continuation is added.

coreStatContinuitySupport.qualification: Separate from the original readWindows and resolverLocalSupport inventories. Prior-word overlap is their union. Four exact functions support only the guarded continuing route and the named helper bypass arms. No complete resolver, nonzero helper-byte path or further callee coverage is asserted.

frameToSelectionSupport.qualification: Separate from the unchanged original readWindows, resolverLocalSupport and coreStatContinuitySupport inventories. Prior overlap is their union. One resolver envelope and seven exact data words support only the guarded frame-to-decision continuation. No helper expansion or presentation, transfer or participant-writer continuation is added.

selectionStoreJoinSupport.qualification: Separate from the unchanged original readWindows, resolverLocalSupport, coreStatContinuitySupport and frameToSelectionSupport inventories. Prior overlap is their union. The initial [0x82CDC6B4,0x82CDC754) query is repeated within the retention envelope. All words reuse prior native support. One exact resolver function closes only the guarded first-store join. No helper or later exit, state-publication, presentation, transfer or participant-writer expansion is added.

localDataflow.composedScalarBlocks: Native 0x82CDABC4 adds the current sub_82CFC0A8 return to current r16; 0x82CDAC18 adds the current sub_82CFBED0 return to current r17. coreStatContinuity carries these opaque return contributions into weighting under its stated guards. Their helper meanings remain unproved.
localDataflow.weightingBlock: At 0x82CDB390, mullw r26,r23,r26 forms low32(A*X), and 0x82CDB394 stores it at r1+156. At 0x82CDB39C, mullw r23,r22,r27 forms low32(D*Y), and 0x82CDB3A0 stores it at r1+160. Under coreStatContinuity, A/D retain the accepted core roles and X/Y are the current composed scalars. Their helper-return contributions have no promoted semantic names.
localDataflow.threefoldBlocks: Under frameToSelection guards, 0x82CDC38C..0x82CDC394 forms low32(3*WA) and stores it at r1+156. 0x82CDC3D0..0x82CDC3D8 forms low32(3*WD) and stores it at r1+160. The same definition byte 1 selects each tripling arm and excludes byte-6 scaling. Zero participant bytes select both division bypasses.
localDataflow.loadedProducerInputs: 0x82CDC424..0x82CDC458 loads current state S, counter C, unsigned modulus M and double scale Q rooted at 0x82F7AD00, forms multiplier 214013 and increment 2531011, and loads ordinal constant 9.0. The complete inspected mask block retains r3/r4/r5/r6/r8/r28 and f0/f13 through entry 0x82CDC640. Current live generator values are conditions, not observations of initialization or distribution.
localDataflow.producer: Within the selection checkpoint block, each local step forms the low 32 bits of state*214013+2531011 and, when M is nonzero, subtracts the unsigned quotient times M.
localDataflow.decision: 0x82CDC674/0x82CDC678 reload low32(3*WA)/low32(3*WD) under frameToSelection. The stepped state is unsigned low32(S*214013+2531011), reduced by unsigned modulus when M is nonzero. 0x82CDC670..0x82CDC6B0 converts that state and the unsigned low-word sum of the two frame words to double, multiplies sum*state*Q, truncates to signed 64-bit and reloads its low word. 0x82CDC6B4/0x82CDC6B8 compares that word signed with low32(3*WA). Less retains r9=1; the other arm sets r9=0. The separately accepted override block at 0x82CDC6C0..0x82CDC6D0 forces 1 when its dereferenced word is nonzero. selectionStoreJoin retains the current +268 pointer and its earlier zero-tested word through this block under explicit native-write and external nonalias conditions. No pointer initialization or global identity is promoted.
localDataflow.ordinal: A second and each retried local step computes double(unsigned state)*Q then multiplies the rounded double by 9.0. fctidz truncates a defined signed 64-bit value, and its low word supplies the ordinal. 0x82CDC72C..0x82CDC73C retries when the native slw bit has no intersection with the comparison-selected mask. slw uses ordinal low six bits and produces zero when bit 5 is set. selectionStoreJoin proves finite success for its concrete examples and preservation across their rejected attempts; it does not prove universal termination.
localDataflow.selectedEffect: When entry executes 0x82CDC640, r7 starts at r1+848 and is retained through the weighted comparison and ordinal retry. 0x82CDC744 stores r9 at r1+848 and 0x82CDC748 stores the ordinal at r1+920 for the first selected entry. 0x82CDC750 then advances r7 by four for another entry. Under the synthetic checkpoint r9=1 and ordinal zero. 0x82CDC760 subtracts bit 1 from r23, the defender-corresponding local mask under the checkpoint role bindings, changing it from 1 to 0; r24 remains 1. The next local loop guard exits because r23 is zero. These are local stack stores; their contents are not joined to presentation or persistent participant writes.
localDataflow.arithmeticExample: For synthetic checkpoint weighted words 300/300, state 3, modulus 4294954991 and scale bits 0x3DF0000301109066, the first three stepped states are 3173050, 471647893 and 2756632324. The first decision word is less than 300 and the second ordinal is zero. This checks the local arithmetic without assuming a core-pair continuation or a captured combat.
localDataflow.retentionBoundary: coreStatContinuity retains WA/WD through frame loads 0x82CDBDE8/0x82CDBDF4. The local definition-byte reductions retain r23/r15 and frame +156/+160. frameToSelection joins those values through its guarded control path, tripling stores, mask construction and the actual selection frame reads 0x82CDC674/0x82CDC678. selectionStoreJoin continues through the retained zero override and finite ordinal success into first stores 0x82CDC744/0x82CDC748. r23 changes from weighted attack to defender mask at 0x82CDC480; the attack value survives in frame +156. Natural reachability and later publication remain unproved.

statFallthroughs.definitionCounts: 0x82CDBE18..0x82CDBE58 and 0x82CDBEFC..0x82CDBF38 count nonzero bits 0, 1 and 2 of the respective current definition byte +0x48. Their equality branches bypass reduction when the count is zero. The denominator in each selected fallthrough is therefore 1, 2 or 3.
statFallthroughs.participantCounts: 0x82CDBE64 and 0x82CDBF44 read halfwords through r14/r18 at current r19+0x52. 0x82CDBE68..0x82CDBE98 and 0x82CDBF48..0x82CDBF78 count bits 0, 1 and 2. Higher bits do not enter the count. The participant/table bindings remain local inputs.
statFallthroughs.first: 0x82CDBEC4 forms low32(participantCount*r23). 0x82CDBECC divides that word signed by the definition count. 0x82CDBEDC sets low32(r29)=low32(r23-quotient). r23 and r1+156 are retained within this block.
statFallthroughs.second: 0x82CDBFA4 forms low32(participantCount*r15). 0x82CDBFAC divides that word signed by the definition count. 0x82CDBFBC sets low32(r30)=low32(r15-quotient). r15 and r1+160 are retained within this block.
statFallthroughs.zeroParticipantExample: With definition byte 1 and participant halfword +0x52 zero, both participant counts and quotients are zero. r29/r30 retain WA/WD. frameToSelection uses these reduced values for its guards, then explicitly changes r30/r31 to Boolean local flags before selection.
statFallthroughs.qualification: The native product is a low word interpreted signed by divw, with truncation toward zero. Normal native execution and valid memory are required. frameToSelection joins one guarded stat-role continuation. No damage or persistent participant update is inferred.

localDataflow.selectionStorePointer: 0x82CDC63C bypasses pointer setup and selection when r24 is zero. On its nonzero fallthrough, 0x82CDC640 is addi r7,r1,848. 0x82CDC648 also bypasses selection when r23 is zero. The instruction sequence 0x82CDC644..0x82CDC750 contains no assignment to r7 before the two stores, including the retry edge 0x82CDC73C -> 0x82CDC6D4. The loop edge 0x82CDC774 -> 0x82CDC644 retains the incremented r7. This is a conditional local stack destination, with no claim that every entry into 0x82CDC644 executes the producer.

frontier.selectionStorePointer: Closed for the guarded first-store route through 0x82CDC640: r7 starts at r1+848 and survives comparison, override and rejected ordinal retries to first stores +848/+920. Later contents retention, presentation publication and persistent participant writes remain unclosed.

frontier.transfer: Given aligned current source/destination and length 144 at the independent transfer checkpoint, 0x827F85CC branches to 0x827F866C. The read prefix ends at 0x827F8684; 0x827F8688 and the transfer stores/return are uninspected. No complete 144-byte publication is promoted.
frontier.participantWriter: No selected-entry publication or exact continuing consumer has been joined to a persistent participant +0x52 write. The local r23 subtraction is a register change. The r7-based writes are conditional local stack writes, not participant writes.
frontier.requiredEvidence: Establish selection contents retention from the first selected stores into presentation, its gate/retention/call path, exact transfer continuation and first participant writer. Natural reachability and live field meanings remain separate requirements. The continuing r25=1 route has no joined later exit or generator publication. Native presentation, pumping and completion must remain in that model.
frontier.stop: The original inventory and resolverLocalSupport remain separate accepted support. coreStatContinuitySupport bounds the additional guarded route to four exact functions and 840 distinct words. Nonzero extent-helper byte and unselected preparation arms are unclosed. The transfer read set remains closed before 0x827F8688. No complete resolver or additional callee coverage is inferred. frameToSelectionSupport adds one exact resolver envelope and seven data words, 572 distinct words including 422 prior words. No helper expansion or claim about the unselected float-adjustment arm is added. selectionStoreJoinSupport reuses 484 prior words in one resolver envelope, with no fresh words or helper expansion. It stops immediately after the first selected stores and pointer increment.

currentEvidence.method: foreground read-only ghidra/DumpMemoryWords.java queries with radius zero; exact native word decoding and arithmetic/branch checks; narrow address-delimited generated-code corroboration
currentEvidence.qualification: Native claims use only raw-matched PPC instructions. Generated corroboration uses narrow address-delimited windows, sequential native mnemonic counting with the eight inline table cells 0x82CDA824..0x82CDA844 accounted separately, and excludes injected ApplyUnitCombatAttackPercent, ApplyUnitCombatDefensePercent and ApplyCombatPaceOverride calls. coreStatContinuity, frameToSelection and selectionStoreJoin establish their guarded stat-to-first-store joins under explicit ABI/nonalias conditions. Other local arithmetic retains its stated checkpoint assumptions. No complete resolver/helper body, unselected arm or natural runtime reachability is asserted.
currentEvidence.resolverLocalChecks: The 278 queried resolver words match the supported flat image. Exact operand and branch decoding plus 384 synthetic low-three-bit cases check both reductions, zero-count bypass polarity, and r23/r15 retention. Exact pointer/store decoding and the inspected selection/retry destinations check r7=r1+848, first stores at frame +848/+920, and the subsequent four-byte increment. These static checks do not establish natural reachability or presentation contents retention.
currentEvidence.coreStatContinuityChecks: All 840 queried words match the supported flat image. A native branch walk checks the 609-instruction guarded resolver route, its 13 calls, stat-register assignment inventory, protected frame stores and exact weighting/load operands. Native decoding checks that 0x82CDAFDC/0x82CDB080 test the same defender terrain byte with consistent zero guards. Selected helper return branches and relative frame extents are checked independently of generated hooks. Three negative mutations detect a stat-register clobber, an extra +156 store and an altered branch target. Explicit nonalias and ABI conditions are not dynamically verified.
currentEvidence.frameToSelectionChecks: All 572 queried words match the pinned flat image. All 565 resolver words decode to the generated mnemonic operands after accounting for the inline table gap. A separate native-word interpreter checks the 434-instruction asymmetric route, four guarded low-byte-zero calls with adversarial volatile-register clobbers, branch polarity, protected frame stores, stat-to-mask register transition, generator operand retention, tripling arithmetic and actual decision loads/comparison. It checks 68 arithmetic cases including the equality/range endpoints and zero modulus. Three negative mutations reject a stat clobber, reversed optional-adjustment bypass and reversed single-bit mask branch. ABI, external nonalias, live generator state and natural reachability remain conditions.
currentEvidence.selectionStoreJoinChecks: All 484 queried words match the pinned flat image, with 484 prior words and zero fresh words. Exact native decoding checks the +268 loads, direct frame-store inventory, generator arithmetic, mask choice, retry destination and first store operands. A separate native-word interpreter checks the continuing S=3 and rejected-retry S=0 examples, zero modulus, low-word counter increments and native slw low-six-bit behavior including shifts 32 and 64. It verifies protected register retention and rejects three mutations: pointer clobber, reversed retry branch and wrong ordinal store operand. Narrow generated locators corroborate the pointer setup and first stores with label-anchored native mnemonic counting and the earlier inline-data gap accounted separately. ABI, external nonalias, finite conversion, valid current pointer values and natural reachability remain conditions.

alternativesAndFalsification: coreStatContinuity, frameToSelection and selectionStoreJoin identify the weighted core values through the first selected stores only under their explicit guards. A different branch, non-normal return, aliased memory effect or lost frame/generator operand invalidates that route. Other resolver arms can alter values or route away before selection.

For entry through 0x82CDC640, the local store base is the stack expression r1+848 and then its four-byte increments. An alternate entry bypassing that producer, later content changes, or an unjoined presentation path cannot be inferred to share the same selected contents.
Different checkpoint masks, arithmetic inputs, ordinal retries, flag overrides or exit guards change the local result and state stores. Their ordinary live reachability is unobserved.
The presentation manager gate can bypass the call, the unread interval can alter r24, and later transfer contents can differ from the local stores. Conditional table targets do not close these edges.
The unread transfer continuation or a later consumer can define publication and participant updates differently than the local mask arithmetic suggests; their exact writers remain required.
Current-image bytes contradicting a recorded operand, branch, constant, table cell or store falsify that independent local finding.
guards: Do not call the local subtraction damage, XP, RNG, death, defeat, capture, or a complete win/loss decision from field shape alone.
Do not infer human/AI, city, naval or air parity, or transfer the selected definition's branches to excluded literal 25 or other special types.
Do not write the neutral flag, generator words, unit fields or local selection stack destinations to force an outcome.
Preserve native presentation target, 0x82CDD938 wait, 0x82CDD958 pump, 0x82CDD978 completion and 0x82CDDEF8 resolver end; accepted participant state changes during that interval.
conclusion: A guarded static continuation retains the accepted core stat pair through weighting, reductions and tripling into the actual selection frame reads, signed comparison, retained zero override and finite successful ordinal retry to first stack stores. It derives masks 1/1 and preserves the selection value and pointer across rejected attempts. The asymmetric S=3 example stores value 1 and ordinal 0 at frame +848/+920. Separate local generator stores retain their independent exit conditions. Selection contents into presentation, full transfer publication and participant +0x52 writes remain unclosed. No naturally reachable ordinary path, live win/loss mechanics or complete combat persistence is established.

checkpointAssumptions.nature: Independent synthetic local examples retain the conditions below. coreStatContinuity, frameToSelection and selectionStoreJoin separately establish composed guarded dataflow without replacing their stat values at a fresh checkpoint. Normal memory access and native execution remain required.
weighting: The synthetic weighting example supplies A/D and neutral scalars X/Y. coreStatContinuity separately establishes conditional retention of the accepted A/D roles to this block and through its frame loads. Neutral scalar values and helper semantics remain supplied assumptions.
At 0x82CDABC4 and 0x82CDAC18, the helper-return and retained-register values are neutral inputs; no generated-only helper body supplies their semantics.

Independent scaling examples can supply current registers at 0x82CDC38C/0x82CDC3D0. frameToSelection instead retains WA/WD from the accepted frame loads, bypasses optional adjustment and selects both tripling arms with the retained Type 16 definition byte 1.
maskConstruction: For the local construction around 0x82CDC45C, assume valid participant/table bindings, definition byte +0x48 = 1, participant halfword +0x52 = 0, and zero byte reads at 0x82CDC4C4/0x82CDC514. The read construction then leaves r24/r23 equal to 1; +0x52 = 1 instead skips adding the bit.

UnitType 16 has the required definition byte in the supported image. frameToSelection establishes guarded arrival and retention of those table/participant bindings into masks 1/1. Their live values and natural reachability remain unobserved.
selection: The independent local selection/exit example supplies r24=r23=1; r20=r25=r30=r31=0; r28=0x82F7AD00; r3=214013/r4=2531011; current state/counter/modulus in r8/r5/r6; and scales Q/9.0 in f0/f13. frameToSelection instead derives masks 1/1, r20=0/r25=1/r30=r31=0 and the generator operands through its inspected loads and mask block. Both entries execute the producer r7=r1+848 at 0x82CDC640. selectionStoreJoin continues the derived r25=1 route into first selected stores while retaining separate later exit assumptions.

Independent local examples supply their frame words. frameToSelection derives frame +156/+160=low32(3*WA)/low32(3*WD) with the accepted attacker/defender orientation. Their positive values remain conditional on its stated inequalities.

The independent local checkpoint supplies a valid pointer and zero pointee at 0x82CDC6C0/0x82CDC6C4. selectionStoreJoin instead retains the valid current +268 pointer and its zero word from 0x82CDBFC4/0x82CDBFC8 under explicit nonalias conditions. Neither case establishes initialization, live values or a global pointer identity.

Entry executes 0x82CDC640, with a valid retained stack frame. The first stores at r1+848 and r1+920 do not overlap the arithmetic frame words or generator state. Later entries advance by four bytes. Destination identity is local; natural reachability and later selected contents retention are unproved.

The independent single-bit example takes the first weighted comparison as 1 and succeeds at ordinal zero. Its later exit and state-store guards, including zero byte at 0x82CDC848, retain their local conditions. selectionStoreJoin closes the first selected stores on the continuing r25=1 route; it does not assert universal ordinal success, the independent later exit, generator publication or later contents retention.

For the numeric example only: WA=WD=300, S=3, M=4294954991 and Q has bits 0x3DF0000301109066. These are synthetic checkpoint inputs; the image's initial state word is not replaced or claimed to have this live value.
transfer: At the transfer call checkpoint, assume a valid eight-byte-aligned current source pointer, destination 0x83024E58 and length 144. The source is not proved to retain the earlier r1+848 stack binding or to contain its selected values.
Normal native returns and valid memory/string inputs are conditions on the separate presentation/consumer endpoint blocks. The manager +0x18 gate and incoming r24 retention remain unclosed.

coreStatContinuity.result: One conditional static route retains the accepted attack and defense words to the weighting stores and reloads their weighted low words at 0x82CDBDE8/0x82CDBDF4. This is a guarded native dataflow result, not an observed ordinary combat path.
guards: Valid accepted participants and frame bindings, both current UnitType reads equal to 16, normal native execution and no arithmetic trap. All participant/table/global storage and bounded text writes are disjoint from the resolver frame words and live input slots.

Every uninspected direct callee returns normally under the native ABI, preserving r1 and nonvolatile GPRs. Its memory effects do not alias protected caller-frame words or their live inputs. This is an explicit ABI/nonalias condition, not verified helper-body behavior.

0x82CDAE38 compares unequal. The defender flags tested at 0x82CDAE4C/0x82CDAEA8 are zero. Attacker terrain byte at 0x82CDAF38 is nonzero. The same defender terrain byte is zero at 0x82CDAFDC/0x82CDB080, taking both branches and bypassing 0x82CDAFE0..0x82CDB000. Both manager-return comparisons at 0x82CDB134/0x82CDB26C are unequal.

Both definition +0x48 bytes are 1 and both participant +0x52 halfwords are zero. Both weighted low words are positive, and signed WA < low32(4*WD). The table word tested at 0x82CDB734 is 13, the defender/global-player comparison at 0x82CDB76C is unequal, and 0x82CDB77C takes the less-than arm.
Resolver mode is zero at 0x82CDB7E4/0x82CDB830. Both player/global-player comparisons at 0x82CDB8E4/0x82CDB920 and all manager comparisons at 0x82CDB96C/0x82CDB97C/0x82CDB9A8/0x82CDB9BC are unequal.

The global byte tested at 0x82CDB9C8/0x82CDBA40/0x82CDBCF8 is zero. The countdown decrement at 0x82CDB9E4 is nonzero, frame +168 at 0x82CDBA94 is zero, and the global word at 0x82CDBAD0 is zero. Frame +148 is zero at 0x82CDBB3C and the global word tested at 0x82CDBB48 is nonzero.

The accepted vtable 0x82138768 is installed at receiver 0x8314F76C. Its +0x1D4 preparation slot selects 0x82D7D730. At its required 0x82D7D854 call, the object passed to 0x82C776C0 has byte +2 zero. 0x82C776E8 therefore takes the no-output return arm at 0x82C778B4.

At 0x82D7D864/0x82D7D868, the existing preparation-local float word at its frame +104 compares less than the current manager float +188. The zero-byte helper arm did not produce that word. Its current comparison is an explicit guard; initialization and natural reachability are unproved.
